nextReadySlice.title: Manifest required-string token validation
failingProof: A failing proof shows required string fields such as artifactName, relativePath, app identity, generator identity, or section contributorId can still accept non-string JSON tokens through permissive conversions.
A failing proof shows malformed required-string JSON can still slip past the test suite without a direct contract-level assertion.
nextReadySlice.reviewGate: Stop again for review before broader hosted/tooling inspection work if required-string validation changes the approved manifest contract or reveals contract drift that needs a design decision.
